BNPL Marketplace

Full-Stack Buy Now, Pay Later Infrastructure

Problem

A BNPL marketplace needs to combine merchant discovery, user eligibility, underwriting, payment-plan generation, and reliable communication between services.

Solution

Built a backend platform supporting merchant discovery and Pay-in-4 / 6 / 12 / 24 financing flows with staged underwriting and signed webhook infrastructure.

Technologies

Python · FastAPI · MySQL · Redis · Docker · Kubernetes · REST APIs · CI/CD

Architecture

  1. Client
  2. FastAPI Services
  3. Eligibility
  4. Three-Stage Underwriting
  5. Financing Plans
  6. Merchant / Transaction Services
  7. Signed Webhooks

Performance

  • 600 merchants
  • 90% search coverage
  • Search P95 <4 ms
  • Autocomplete <1 ms
  • 53 automated tests
  • Containerized deployment with health probes and autoscaling support.
